claims: The 98th Academy Awards occurred on March 15, 2026.
A tie occurred in the Best Live Action Short Film category at the 98th Academy Awards.
The tie was between "The Singers" (Sam A. Davis and Jack Piatt) and "Two People Exchanging Saliva" (Alexandre Singh and Natalie Musteata).
The tie marks the seventh tie in Oscar history.
Previous ties at the Oscars occurred in 2012, 1994, 1986, 1968, 1949, and 1931/32.
